finding.finding: Two authoritative reports give separate equipment-status claims for Veyangoda (VEY93/S20): hardware fault at observed time 0, then alarm cleared and KPIs normal at observed time 5. Preserve both time-specific claims.

S20 equipment status is unresolved because two verified reports conflict. No road or asset constraints otherwise block catalogued work; no action should be deferred solely due to this conflict. Equipment repair cannot be assumed to resolve status; generator deployment only provides temporary power.

questions.question: Please confirm whether S20 equipment is faulty and requires repair, or is operational; verified reports conflict.

finding.finding: V20 at Veyangoda (S20) is the only service assigned critical status, with the approved weight of 5; all other services have standard weight 1. The reports contain conflicting authoritative NMS observations for Veyangoda: a hardware fault and cells out of service at 06:00, followed by a cleared alarm and normal KPIs at 06:05. Recency alone does not resolve this conflict, and equipment status remains unknown in the resolved state. The Bandaragama complaint and Piliyandala planned power notice do not establish a listed service outage. No outage can be reliably ranked from the supplied evidence.

questions.question: Please confirm Veyangoda service equipment status: NMS reported cells out of service at 06:00 and normal KPIs after an alarm clearance at 06:05, while the resolved state leaves equipment status unknown.

findings: V2-12-OBS-01 identifies VEY93, which matches directory site S20, and reports an RRU hardware fault with cells out of service; the extracted equipment_ok=false claim is supported.

V2-12-OBS-02 identifies the same site and reports the hardware alarm cleared and KPIs normal; equipment_ok=true is supported. These reports conflict over the site's current equipment state, and the unresolved fact is preserved rather than guessed.

The Bandaragama complaint is not an asset-status claim. The Piliyandala notice is a planned future interruption and identifies no listed site. Neither supports a verified operational fact or makes an action unsafe here; the plan has no actions to defer.
